text:
Noah T: hey all, first week here. quick security onboarding Qs: 1) i already registered my YubiKey but its flaky on mac sleepdo we rotate/re-register keys often? 2) my manager scheduled the phishing training during a product demo, can i move it? 3) is there a one-click flow to report a suspected phish from mobile?

Hannah S: welcome Noah :wave: on YubiKeyswe recommend re-registering if it becomes flaky. rotation policy: rotate only if lost, compromised, or hardware failure. for flaky hardware try re-plugging, re-register in Okta (Settings -> Security Methods -> Add YubiKey) and ensure youre on corp VPN during initial bind.

IT Bot: Ticket created: IT-69812 for device diagnostics (owner: Hannah S). Please attach device serial if flaky persists.

Security Bot: phishing training can be rescheduled in the training portal (https://redwood.internal/training) or reply with two alternate windows and People Ops will adjust. mobile reporting: open the phishing report form (https://redwood.internal/sec/report-phish) or forward the email to report@redwood.internal. forwarding from mobile counts as a report.

People Ops: Noah, we moved your training to tomorrow 23pm per your demo timing. welcome aboard!

Noah T: thanks everyone. serial for my mac ends in 5C9. i'll re-register the YubiKey on VPN and update the ticket if it still fails. also good to know about mobile reporting :thumbsup:
